newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Air China jumbo makes emergency landing.
newsitem.headline: Air China jumbo makes emergency landing.

text.p: An Air China Boeing 747 flying between Shanghai and Paris was forced to make an emergency landing in Sweden due to engine problems, a spokesman for Stockholm's international airport Arlanda said on Thursday.

The jet, carrying 181 people, requested permission to land at Arlanda late on Wednesday after a large sheet of metal was seen flapping from one of the wings and the aircraft started to experience problems with one engine.
"This sheet of metal covers a section under the wing and eye witnesses say it had come loose," spokesman Andris Zvejnieks said.
"The airline reported problems with one engine and it landed at Arlanda. There was never any danger to the passengers."
He said the aircraft would remain in Sweden for repairs but the passengers had been put onto other flights bound for Paris.
Zvejnieks said Air China will prepare a report on the incident for the Swedish authorities.
